verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports per-environment task versions ('locked to the latest version of the code for that environment') and ships a local 'Dev mode' for testing/iterating that community users praise as 'an absolute gem' distinct from production, plus a CLI for local development separate from deployment. This gives AI-native users a genuine dev/staging sandbox to test tasks without touching production runs or data. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs detailing environment/data isolation guarantees (e.g., separate DBs or staging environment specifics) and independent hands-on confirmation that sandbox data never leaks into production.
